name: 3D Print Studio
description:
Mixed-duration print jobs meet a finishing queue.

How does variability affect flow when the average print time is unchanged?

Starting assumptions
• An eight-hour shift with an illustrative mix of 5–60 minute print jobs.
• Two printers operate without a shared operator requirement; finishing needs one worker.
• Print duration samples are invented. Geometry, material use, thermal behavior and batch packing are excluded.

Synthetic teaching models. Timings, demand and staffing are illustrative; layout does not add travel time.
